    • restoreCardContentFromBin

      public void restoreCardContentFromBin(Long cardContentId)
      PUT api/cardContents/{cardContentId: [0-9]+}/RestoreFromBin calls CardContentRestEndpoint.restoreCardContentFromBin(java.lang.Long) Restore from the bin. The object won't contain any deletion or erasure data anymore.

      It means that the object is back at its place (as much as possible).

      Parameters:
      cardContentId - the id of the card content
      Throws:
      HttpErrorMessage - if card content does not exist
